text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while walking down the hallway... 
Two familiar faces were confronting each 
other.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Your physical strength is truly unmatched 
in Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I want to know the source of that power— I 
won't back down until you grant me an 
interview...!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: I must politely decline.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"If you insist on it so badly... Then stop 
me yourself and get your interview."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: —If you can, that is.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gentildonna boasts the greatest power in 
the academy. Trying to stop her just for 
an interview... is frankly reckless.
choice_data_list: Is there any way to stop them...?!
Is there any way to stop them...?!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, my assessment is that it'll 
be quite tough. A head-on clash is bound 
to end in defeat.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
—However, there's nothing left to do but 
try. I'll hit them with the "strongest" 
intellect I've got!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Now then, first up is a light crawl—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Mind if I take the seat next to you? —Now 
then, shall we begin?"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
(In the water with buoyancy, there's a 
chance I can grab hold somewhere on her 
body and stop her. This is my golden 
opportunity...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The two started swimming at the same time! 
But—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
(Wha...?! Such speed?! Such power!! Ngh... 
The wake she's kicking up is like a 
whirlpool...!)

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: (I-I can't get close...!!)

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Oh, dumbbells and chest expanders? "Please 
feel free to use"... huh.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I knew you'd take the bait! Your favorite 
workout equipment is broken and being 
repaired right now, after all.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Using your full body right now, you 
shouldn't be able to shake me off. 
Gentildonna-san, I've got you!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Training even while walking!? Wait, 
h-hold on... N-Nggghhh!! I'm being dragged 
along... I-I can't stop...!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *pant*... She slipped right 
through my fingers...
choice_data_list:
We're on a completely different level of 
power...!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
She easily exceeded my expectations. She 
is strong as an Umamusume... no, as a 
living creature.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Just as I thought, you truly are the 
"strongest"... but still—!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Oh, my... You're still here.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Yes—because there are still the finishing 
touches left to do!!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Hmphhh!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Royce and Royce clashed head-on, grappling 
with Gentildonna. It was a reckless, 
bull-headed tactic...!
choice_data_list: Coming full circle to a simple strategy!?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Haa, something like this... ...? Oh my, 
this is—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"Just like a giant boulder. In that 
case...!"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
There it is, the right leg!!! Diving into 
the water, kicking off in the crawl—and 
just like during walking muscle training, 
movement centered on the right leg!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
That habit of yours whenever you dig your 
feet in...!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Fatigue has been piling up, hasn't it? 
I've calculated that even I can stop you 
right now if I apply force to your right 
thigh!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Haaaaahhhhh----!!!!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: You seem to know quite a lot about me.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: However—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Kyaaaaaaaaーー!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gentildonna held off Royce and Royce, 
sprinting clear all the way through.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
*pant* *pant* *pant*... Gah, I'm 
completely out of options...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: An interview... I really wanted one...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Oh, do we not need to?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Respect should be given, shouldn't it? To 
her intellect, which rivals my power.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"It is an honor, Gentile-san. Now I can 
cover the story to my heart's content!"
choice_data_list:
What kind of things are you planning to 
ask?

What kind of things are you planning to 
ask?

I'm so glad they accepted it without any 
trouble...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"It is an honor, Gentile-san. Now I can 
cover the story to my heart's content!"
choice_data_list:
What kind of things are you planning to 
ask?

What kind of things are you planning to 
ask?

I'm so glad they accepted it without any 
trouble...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I have an endless number of questions, 
mainly about your mindset and theories 
during training! We'll be doing a full 
week of in-depth coverage!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"My, so you were hiding it. Thinking I 
would refuse if you presented it upfront."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that's how it is. A promise is a 
promise, so just give up and accept it♪

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
True. Though if she had gone all out, the 
result might have been different.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Giggle... Oh, you noticed?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Heh, I have a few hidden trump cards of my 
own, you know.

text_block_list.name: Royce & Gentile
text_block_list.text: Ohohohohoho!
